dedupe_keys.name: identificacion de areas potenciales de distribucion de vertebrados terrestres en un contexto de cambio climatico de inecc

description: Identificación de áreas potenciales de distribución de vertebrados terrestres en un contexto de cambio climático de INECC is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático (INECC). Con el objetivo de abonar a la conservación de la biodiversidad y la conectividad en un contexto de cambio climático, fueron identificadas áreas potencialmente importantes para la distribución de vertebrados terrestres endémicos en tres regiones del país. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático (INECC). Its tags are biodiversidad, cambio climático, conservación recursos naturales, ecosistema, energía. It offers 7 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
